verdict.rationale: Stripe processes customer and transaction data and uses AI (e.g., Radar), so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data can be excluded from model training; the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of an AI-training opt-out, data-usage control, or training-exclusion policy, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
